## `mainframe.adapter`

**Status:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)

A mainframe I/O adapter card, representing a physical PCIe adapter that connects the Central Processing Complex (CPC) to networks, storage, or provides cryptographic and acceleration services.

**Type:** `mainframe.adapter`

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**Attributes:**

| Role | Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Identity | [`mainframe.adapter.id`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-adapter-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The physical channel identifier (PCHID) of the I/O adapter. [1] | `014`; `15C`; `1D8` |
| Identity | [`virtualization.platform.id`](/docs/registry/virtualization/README.md#virtualization-platform-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | Unique identifier for the virtualization platform. [2] | `3931-45A01`; `4c4c4544-0042-3510-8058-b4c04f4e3732` |
| Description | [`mainframe.adapter.type`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-adapter-type) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | The type of the mainframe I/O adapter card. [3] | `crypto`; `flash`; `roce` |
| Description | [`mainframe.adapter.name`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-adapter-name) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The name of the I/O adapter as configured on the Hardware Management Console (HMC). [4] | `Cloud Network 0014 A10B-06`; `OSD 0114` |
| Description | [`mainframe.adapter.owning.partition`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-adapter-owning-partition) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The name of the logical partition (LPAR) that owns the I/O adapter when dedicated, or 'shared' when the adapter is shared across partitions. [5] | `LPAR01`; `shared` |

**[1] `mainframe.adapter.id`:** The PCHID is the hexadecimal location of the adapter in the Central Processing Complex (CPC) and is unique within one CPC. Reported by the HMC Web Services API adapter object field `adapter-id`.

**[2] `virtualization.platform.id`:** The Central Processing Complex (CPC) the adapter is installed in.

**[3] `mainframe.adapter.type`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API adapter object field `type`. Used to distinguish network, storage, cryptographic, and accelerator adapters when aggregating per-type utilization metrics.

**[4] `mainframe.adapter.name`:** User-assignable, so descriptive only. Reported by the HMC Web Services API adapter object field `name`.

**[5] `mainframe.adapter.owning.partition`:** Derived from the IBM Z HMC Web Services API adapter object property `partitions-assigned-to-adapter`, an array of assigned-partition-info objects. Set to 'shared' when more than one partition is assigned.

---

`mainframe.adapter.type` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accelerator` | An accelerator adapter, providing hardware acceleration for specific workloads such as compression or AI inference. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `crypto` | A cryptographic (crypto) adapter, providing hardware-accelerated encryption and key management. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `flash` | A Flash Express adapter, providing solid-state storage for IBM Virtual Flash Memory (VFM). | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `network` | A network adapter providing connectivity to external networks. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `roce` | A RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE) adapter, providing low-latency RDMA networking over Ethernet. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `storage` | A storage adapter providing connectivity to external storage systems such as SAN or NVMe-oF. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |

| Identity | [`mainframe.adapter.port.id`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-adapter-port-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The identifier of the physical port on a mainframe network adapter. [7] | `0`; `1` |
| Identity | [`virtualization.platform.id`](/docs/registry/virtualization/README.md#virtualization-platform-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | Unique identifier for the virtualization platform. [8] | `3931-45A01`; `4c4c4544-0042-3510-8058-b4c04f4e3732` |

On UNIX systems, it may contain what the hostname command returns, or the fully qualified hostname, or another name specified by the user. [9] | `opentelemetry-test` |

**[6] `mainframe.adapter.id`:** The PCHID of the adapter that contains this port.

**[7] `mainframe.adapter.port.id`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API network-physical-adapter-port metric group field `network-port-id`. In distributed systems terms, this is analogous to the port number on a multi-port NIC.

**[8] `virtualization.platform.id`:** The Central Processing Complex (CPC) the adapter is installed in.

**[9] `host.name`:** The name of the Central Processing Complex (CPC) that owns the adapter hosting this port.

## `mainframe.channel`

**Status:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)

A mainframe I/O channel, representing a physical channel path that connects the Central Processing Complex (CPC) to peripheral devices — the mainframe equivalent of a network or storage interface card port.

**Type:** `mainframe.channel`

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**Attributes:**

| Role | Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Identity | [`mainframe.channel.name`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-channel-name) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The name of the I/O channel in the form CSS.Chpid. [10] | `0.00`; `0.2D`; `1.E3` |
| Identity | [`virtualization.platform.id`](/docs/registry/virtualization/README.md#virtualization-platform-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | Unique identifier for the virtualization platform. [11] | `3931-45A01`; `4c4c4544-0042-3510-8058-b4c04f4e3732` |
| Description | [`mainframe.channel.mode`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-channel-mode) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | The operating mode of the I/O channel — either dedicated to a single partition or shared across partitions. | `dedicated`; `shared` |
| Description | [`mainframe.channel.id`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-channel-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The channel path identifier (CHPID) in hexadecimal format. [12] | `00`; `2D`; `E3` |
| Description | [`mainframe.channel.owning.partition`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-channel-owning-partition) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The name of the logical partition (LPAR) that owns the I/O channel when dedicated, or 'shared' when the channel is shared across partitions. [13] | `LPAR01`; `shared` |
| Description | [`mainframe.channel.type`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-channel-type) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The protocol and connectivity type of the I/O channel path. [14] | `ficon`; `zhyperlink`; `osa` |

**[10] `mainframe.channel.name`:** `CSS.CHPID` is unique within one CPC; the bare CHPID is not, because it repeats across channel subsystems.

**[11] `virtualization.platform.id`:** The Central Processing Complex (CPC) the channel belongs to.

**[12] `mainframe.channel.id`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API channel-path object. In distributed systems terms, this is analogous to a storage HBA port or channel identifier.

**[13] `mainframe.channel.owning.partition`:** Reported by the IBM Z HMC Web Services API `channel-usage` metric group field `logical-partition-name`. The field is 'shared' when the channel is shared across partitions, and an empty string for channel types that do not expose an owning partition (for example coupling channels).

**[14] `mainframe.channel.type`:** Reported by the IBM Z HMC Web Services API adapter object property `type`, whose values include `ficon`, `osa`, `hipersockets` and `network-express`.

---

`mainframe.channel.mode` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dedicated` | The I/O channel is dedicated to a specific partition and cannot be shared with other partitions. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `shared` | The I/O channel can be shared among multiple partitions and is not dedicated to a specific partition. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |

---

`mainframe.channel.type` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `coupling` | Coupling Facility link (Integrated Cluster Bus or Coupling Express) for sysplex communication. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `ficon` | Fibre Channel Connection (FICON) channel path for high-speed DASD and tape storage connectivity. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `osa` | Open Systems Adapter (OSA) channel path for Ethernet LAN connectivity. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `roce` | RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE) channel path for high-speed memory-to-memory data transfers. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `zhyperlink` | zHyperLink express channel path providing ultra-low-latency synchronous PCIe storage access. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |

**[15] `mainframe.cpu.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API processor object. In distributed systems terms, a mainframe processor is analogous to a physical CPU core.

**[16] `virtualization.platform.id`:** The Central Processing Complex (CPC) the processor belongs to; processor names such as `CP02` repeat on every CPC.

---

`mainframe.cpu.type` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aap` | Application Assist Processor (AAP), a processor dedicated to accelerating Java and XML processing for database workloads. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `all` | All types of mainframe processors combined. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `cbp` | Container Based Processor (CBP), a processor type for container-based workloads. Present only in HMC/SE versions 2.14.0 through 2.15.0. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `cp` | Central Processor (CP), the general-purpose processor that hosts a mainframe operating system such as z/OS. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `icf` | Integrated Coupling Facility (ICF), a processor dedicated to running coupling facility workloads for high-speed communication between systems in a sysplex. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `ifl` | Integrated Facility for Linux (IFL), a processor dedicated to running Linux workloads on the mainframe. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `iip` | z Integrated Information Processor (zIIP), a processor dedicated to offloading eligible workloads such as Java applications from general-purpose processors. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `sap` | System Assist Processor (SAP), a processor dedicated to system management and I/O processing workloads. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |

**[17] `mainframe.partition.nic.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API partition-attached-network-interface metric group. In distributed systems terms, this is analogous to a virtual NIC (vNIC) attached to a virtual machine.

**[18] `virtualization.partition.id`:** The DPM partition that owns this NIC (on IBM Z, its partition name).

**[19] `virtualization.platform.id`:** The Central Processing Complex (CPC) that hosts the partition.

**[20] `host.name`:** The name of the Central Processing Complex (CPC) that hosts the partition owning this NIC.

**[21] `mainframe.adapter.id`:** The PCHID of the physical adapter backing this virtual NIC.

**[22] `mainframe.adapter.port.id`:** The port ID on the physical adapter backing this virtual NIC.
